baseline_models.mechanism: Labor is the driver rather than Mary: bodily contraction compels her to an external, rigid point of contact at the palm trunk.

activation_trace.role: Compelled arrival makes labor, not Mary, the force that carries the movement toward the trunk.
Birth pangs supply the internal bodily disturbance that drives the scene.
The tree trunk supplies a firm external terminus and bodily brace.
The date palm identifies the living structure at which the compelled movement stops.

changed_reading.before: Mary goes to a palm tree while labor begins.
changed_reading.after: Labor takes grammatical and causal agency, forcing Mary into contact with the palm trunk as an imposed threshold.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا
baseline_models.mechanism: The wish reaches beyond death: temporal precedence, ceased life, completed being, and doubled discard language combine into a desire to have become negligible before the present can attach to her.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life supplies the first layer of the wished-for exit.
Temporal precedence moves that exit to a point before the present crisis.
Completed being turns the wish from a momentary feeling into an imagined prior state.
The doubled phrase classifies the desired self as a cast-off thing beneath notice, not merely as someone absent from memory.

changed_reading.before: She wishes she had died earlier and been forgotten.
changed_reading.after: She tries imaginatively to preempt the present by having already passed from personhood into the status of discarded, unattended matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unit begins by commanding Mary's recollection in a written record, so the doubled wish for oblivion is preserved by the very discourse that reports it.

activation_trace.role: Active recollection directly reverses the focus phrase's desired removal from memory.
The written record gives durable form to the recollection and prevents the utterance from disappearing.
The wished-for cast-off object is the state that commanded recollection and writing refuse to grant.

structural_cues: 19:16 opens the unit with an imperative to remember Mary in the book; 19:23 closes her utterance with two forms of the forget-root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded recollection, a written record, and doubled oblivion language; I infer that narration reverses her requested erasure, while the live alternative is that 19:16 merely frames the account without commenting on her wish.

changed_reading.before: Mary asks to leave no memory behind.
changed_reading.after: Her request for erasure becomes the most durably remembered speech in the unit, producing a reflexive reversal between her wish and the record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated withdrawal develops into imagined self-disposal: Mary first moves herself to the side, then wants to cease being an agent and become the thing cast aside.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal to a side begins the spatial movement away from family and social view.
The casting-away image sharpens the second withdrawal into a bridge toward object-like disposal.
The discarded forgotten thing is the terminal state toward which the repeated retreat now points.

structural_cues: The same withdrawal verb occurs in 19:16 and immediately before the focus in 19:22, followed by the focus's doubled object-state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two withdrawals and a wish to be discarded; I infer an escalation from self-directed retreat to loss of agency as refuse, while ordinary privacy remains a live explanation of the withdrawals.

changed_reading.before: The remote location is background for an isolated birth.
changed_reading.after: The location belongs to an escalating retreat mechanism in which chosen distance culminates in a wish to be socially and materially thrown away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coming birth has already been assigned the values of gift, visible sign, mercy, and settled decree; Mary's response seeks the exact opposite, a self with no visible or remembered trace.

activation_trace.role: Gift without exchange supplies the announced positive status of the child.
Mercy adds a beneficent value that sharply contrasts with Mary's self-negating response.
A visible sign gives the event public legibility rather than privacy.
A cutting, settled decree makes the event non-negotiable before labor arrives.
Discarded obscurity is Mary's counter-position to the event's announced public value.

structural_cues: 19:19-21 assigns meaning to the birth before 19:22-23 moves from conception to labor and Mary's utterance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, mercy, sign, decree, and self-erasure; I infer a collision between public meaning and private bearability, while pain alone could still account for the lament.

changed_reading.before: The line is a private reaction to unbearable labor.
changed_reading.after: The line stages a conflict between an event already made publicly meaningful and the bearer who wishes to have no public trace at all.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two agitations are paired around the same trunk: involuntary bodily disturbance drives Mary to it, then commanded bodily movement shakes it and releases ripe food. The endpoint of compulsion becomes a responsive source of provision.

activation_trace.role: Labor supplies the first, involuntary bodily agitation.
The trunk is initially the terminus to which labor forces her.
Deliberate shaking supplies a second agitation, now directed outward by Mary.
Repetition of the exact trunk makes the earlier terminus the object of productive action.
Downward falling is the material response released by the second agitation.
Ripe dates specify that the response is immediately nourishing rather than merely kinetic.
Harvest taken from its growth completes the conversion of motion into provision.

structural_cues: The palm trunk of 19:23 is repeated in 19:25, with bodily movement on both sides and a concrete yield only after the second movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies labor, the repeated trunk, shaking, falling, ripeness, and harvest; I infer a paired agitation-response mechanism, while the live alternative is a simple sequence of pain followed by unrelated aid.

changed_reading.before: The trunk is an inert support reached during labor.
changed_reading.after: The trunk is a latent provisioning interface: the place where involuntary bodily force ends becomes the place where Mary's directed force elicits food.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's voiced lament is followed by restraint of her tongue, a nonverbal indication, and speech from the child. The focus utterance becomes a hinge at which the burden of explanation begins to leave her voice.

activation_trace.role: Mary's audible saying exposes her own crisis in her own words.
Restraint of the tongue interrupts Mary's direct verbal engagement with people.
Intelligible exchange is explicitly the activity Mary will withhold.
A bodily indication replaces Mary's spoken defense.
The child's audible saying takes over the explanatory speech Mary no longer supplies.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from Mary's saying in 19:23 to prescribed non-speaking in 19:26, pointing in 19:29, and the child's saying in 19:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies utterance, tongue-restraint, gesture, and replacement speech; I infer a redistribution of testimonial agency, while a ritual silence followed by a separate miracle remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The lament is one isolated expression of pain.
changed_reading.after: The lament is Mary's last unmediated disclosure before defense passes from her voice to silence, gesture, and finally the child's voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated come-root reverses agency: in the focus labor compels Mary to come, but her people later address her as the one who has brought the extraordinary matter. Social grammar assigns her authorship of what bodily grammar imposed on her.

activation_trace.role: Compulsion marks Mary as the object of labor's force.
Bringing a thing recasts Mary as the addressed agent responsible for presenting the event.
The assembled people supply the social body that performs the reassignment of agency.
The extraordinary, shocking matter supplies the charged object they say she has brought.

structural_cues: 19:23 uses a causative form with labor as driver; 19:27 repeats the root in second-person address with Mary as the one who came bearing the matter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the causative arrival and the later second-person accusation; I infer that anticipated agency reversal helps explain the wish for prior erasure, while the lament may still arise before any conscious anticipation of the crowd.

changed_reading.before: Mary wishes for death because labor has overwhelmed her.
changed_reading.after: Her wish also fits a threatened injustice of agency: she experiences the event as something done to her, yet will be spoken to as though she authored and brought it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary tries to move death to before the present event; the child's later declaration sets birth, death, and renewed life in an ordered sequence, countering her attempted temporal inversion without erasing its anguish.

activation_trace.role: Temporal priority is the operator by which Mary tries to relocate death.
Death is the event she wishes to place before the current threshold.
Birth opens the later explicitly ordered life sequence.
Death returns in its ordinary position after birth rather than before the focus event.
Rousing from stillness extends the sequence beyond death and denies it final control of the timeline.

structural_cues: The focus explicitly says death before this; 19:33 names the days of birth, death, and being raised alive in that order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Mary's precedence marker and the later three-stage sequence; I infer a narrative correction of temporal order, while the later declaration may function independently as a formula of protection.

changed_reading.before: Before simply locates an earlier wished-for death.
changed_reading.after: Before marks an attempted reordering of the life sequence that the child's later speech restates as birth, then death, then renewed life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the sifting and selection branches of the palm-root rather than the contextual tree sense. It remains anchored in the focus palm and discarded-object phrase, and 19:25 supplies ripe, choice harvest from the same trunk. Downstream prose should present it as a branch-image analogy, not as an alternative lexical translation of palm.

activation_trace.role: Sifting activates a material sorting process inside the literal palm image.
The cast-off negligible thing supplies the rejected side of that sorting image.
Ripe dates supply the retained, nourishing product.
The choice portion of the harvest sharpens the contrast between selected fruit and imagined refuse.

changed_reading.before: The palm is a tree beside which Mary wishes to be forgotten.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the palm becomes a sorting image: while it yields ripe choice fruit, Mary tries to classify herself as the residue no one keeps.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form means temporal before, whereas the receiver-at-birth image is a distant branch of the same root. Labor and the later birth sequence keep the activation anchored and make the threshold image worth carrying. Downstream prose must retain the temporal syntax and label the receiving image as resonance only.

activation_trace.role: Labor places the utterance at the bodily threshold of delivery.
The receiver who meets what emerges at birth overlays a receiving threshold on the temporal word.
Explicit occurrence of birth later in the unit keeps the receiving image tied to the scene's actual process.

changed_reading.before: She only wishes death had occurred earlier.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch resonance, she wishes to have escaped before reaching the very threshold at which a new life is received.

strongest_changes: The command to remember Mary in a written record reverses her doubled wish to become forgotten refuse.
The repeated come-root moves her from one compelled by labor to one accused of bringing the event, exposing a reversal of agency.
The repeated trunk changes from the endpoint of involuntary pain into a responsive source of provision under directed movement.
Her lament becomes the hinge before explanation passes through silence and gesture to the child's speech.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is activated most strongly by reversals of memory, agency, material response, voice, and temporal order rather than by one harmonized theme.
remaining_uncertainties: The relative force of bodily pain, anticipated social accusation, and conflict with the event's public meaning remains open.
The sieve and receiving-threshold readings are branch-image resonances, not claims about the contextual lexical senses.
